changelog: polish: STAMP error bars stop at 100% and the figure states its method and sample size. With 2 samples per group mean + 1.96 SE ran past 100% (Bacillota in feed reached ~140%), which no relative abundance can. The subtitle now reads 'Top 25 by abundance · mean ± 1.96 SE · n = 2 vs 2 · * = q < 0.05' and adds 'too few samples per group for a reliable test' below 3 per group. Checked against the 2.9.28 render: 49 figures, nothing missing; both 17_beta_heatmap figures and the three 19_stamp figures drawn; volcano reads 'Reactor vs feed'.

previous.changelog: fix: the sample-by-sample beta heatmaps (17_beta_heatmap_bray/jaccard) came and went between renders; STAMP figures never drew. (1) Root cause, from r_render.log: by section 17 a stray device was open (ggplot opens R's default device on its own when building a figure). pheatmap measures text on a throw-away pdf(NULL) and when it closes it R makes the next device current - the stray one - so the heatmap was drawn there, our PNG never received a page and no file was written, while the log still said Saved. open_dev() now closes every open device before opening the figure's own. Reproduced (bray lost with the old code, both drawn now). (2) The clean-up added in 2.9.26 read the figure's path after dev.off() had cleared it, giving "invalid 'file' argument" - the jaccard heatmap's error in 2.9.27. (3) STAMP (19_stamp_*) failed at every rank with 'names do not match previous names': it rbind()-ed one data.frame per taxon after Bioconductor packages had replaced rbind. It now builds the table column by column, and sums names split across lineages first (duplicated names would also have broken factor()). (4) ANCOMBC2 volcano subtitle reads 'Reactor vs feed' instead of 'Grouping4Reactor'.
